opening.argument: The presentation promotes PlusToken as a way to receive daily passive income, including returns of up to 18%, and directs viewers to register through information in the video description. The earning structure also ties income to partners across multiple sponsor lines, with commissions extending from the first line through the tenth. Viewers are instructed to enter the recommending person's referral card when registering and then use their own referral card with their partners. Those features establish the scam at issue: the passive-income promise is coupled to a tiered recruitment structure, making recruitment central to the promoted earnings.
